_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Instructional Performance Requirements Document
summary: Provides mission, and collective and individual task information, along with knowledge, skills, attitudes, and learning objective listings for tasks selected for training, to support the design of a training program.
use_relationship:
This document provides mission, and collective and individual task information. This document also provides listings of knowledge, skills, attitudes, and learning objectives for the tasks that have been selected for training. The Instructional Performance Requirements Document contains data necessary to support the design of a training program.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the preparation instructions for the content and format of the Instructional Performance Requirements Document.

This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the performance requirements described by 3.2.2 of MIL-PRF-29612B, and is applicable to the acquisition of training data products. Data product performance evaluation criteria are specified in 4.3.2 of MIL-PRF-29612B.

It is not intended that all the requirements contained herein be applied to every program or program phase. Any individual data requirement contained in this DID is subject to deletion tailoring.

This DID supersedes DI-SESS-81518C.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The contractor format is acceptable. Standard digital data, when specified, must be in compliance with the content and format requirements specified in the DoD Data Architecture (DDA) and the Defense Data Dictionary System (DDDS). The deliverable of the product required by this DID meets the intent and requirements of DODINST 5000.2.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Instructional Performance Requirements Document shall provide the following:

children.title: Front matter
children.content: The content of front matter shall be in accordance with Appendix A of MIL-PRF-29612B.

children.title: Introduction
children.content: The introduction shall specify the purpose, scope, and intended use of the Instructional Performance Requirements Document, as well as the background information and a description of the methodology used in each of the analyses utilized to develop the information.

children.title: Part 1: Mission, and collective and individual task data
children.content: The task data contains the requirements for the mission, and collective and individual tasks as follows:

children.title: Mission information
children.content: This data shall consist of the following:

children.title: Stated missions related to unit mission
Implied missions related to each stated mission
Mission scenarios (e.g., combat functions, aircrew, tank crew)
A description of the segments for each of the missions
children.content: (Each mission phase or segment consists of a collection of related functions and tasks with a common outcome, timing, and contribution to total mission performance.)

children.title: Collective and individual task information
children.content: The task information shall consist of the following:

children.title: Task description, to include a single unit of specific work behavior with clear beginning and ending points
Tools, equipment, and materials related to the task
Relationship of collective tasks to individual tasks
List of all individual tasks for each collective task
Relationship of tasks to each mission
Environmental, safety, and risk analysis requirements
Training task selection criteria for each task
Percentage of personnel, by occupational specialty and skill level, who perform the task
Identification number and title of the following type references to the task
Combat functions related to the task
System related to task (e.g., weapon system, information system, management system)
Information requirements shall include input information, decision/judgmental requirements, information processing information, control adequacy of feedback response, and acceptable feedback results
Diagram requirements shall include task diagrams to clarify task descriptions where applicable
children.content: (Diagram types include tabular, functional flow, hierarchical input and output process, operational sequence, and others.)

children.title: Task lists
children.content: The task lists shall be comprised of:

children.title: Training data matrix
children.content: The training data matrix shall identify the system level or subsystems/equipment, and the task to be performed. It shall also include a matrix listing of the system level and subsystem/equipment level.

children.title: Task information summary and clarification
children.content: The summary shall include the data collector's qualification of collective and individual task information in the context of current and future operations.

children.title: Part 2: Training task data
children.content: The training task data shall include listings of knowledge, skills, and attitudes for the tasks that have been selected for training. The training task data shall include:

children.title: Training task lists
children.content: Listings of training tasks shall be provided as follows:

children.title: Collective training tasks with knowledge, skills, and attitudes for each collective training task
Individual training tasks with knowledge, skills, and attitudes for each individual training task
Collective and individual training task data
children.content: Collective and individual training task data shall include the following for each task selected for training:

children.title: Collective and individual training task data shall contain
An indication if the training task can be supported using job aids
The training task hierarchies data shall establish relationships among training tasks by learning type (domain) and learning outcome
Training exercise data
children.content: Training exercise data shall include the following:

children.title: Exercise title used for training each collective task
Threat situation for exercise or drill
Results of war gaming exercise or drills
Relationship of exercise with exercises of subordinate units
Approvals (e.g., analyst, reviewer, revisions) with dates
List of all collective tasks associated with exercise
List of all individual tasks associated with exercise
Part 3: Learning objectives data
children.content: The Learning Objectives (LO) data shall include information related to the design of training courses as follows:

children.title: Training course data
children.content: Training course data shall include the following:

children.title: Knowledge, skills, attitudes, and information required for each LO
Trainee prerequisite knowledge and skills required for each LO
Hierarchies of LOs based on types and learning outcomes/domain
Strategy for combining, sequencing, and presenting LOs
Setting for each course or LO
Learning events and activities for each LO
Media by instructional progression: Introduce; Practice; Validate
Instructional methods selected for each LO
Requirements and concerns for safety and environmental issues for each LO
Training sequence lists LO and sub tasks/items within the LO
Learning objective to training task cross-reference as follows
Lists of tasks supported by each LO, with task number, Topic, Unit or Program of Instruction number
LOs supporting each task, with task number, Topic, Unit or Program of Instruction number
Learning objective hierarchies and flow diagrams
children.content: These diagrams shall contain LOs arranged in a hierarchical relationship with flow diagrams to describe the superordinate, ordinate, subordinate, and sequential relationship among LOs.

children.title: Learning analysis summary
children.content: The learning analysis summary shall contain the mission statement, course objective, LO, and the knowledge, skills, and attitudes to support the LOs. The summary shall provide a listing of LOs and the knowledge, skills, and attitudes required to perform the tasks. The summary shall be arranged in a sequence appropriate for presentation.

children.title: Part 4: Knowledge, skills, abilities and attitudes analysis data
children.content: This data shall include the following:

children.title: Procedures
children.content: This data shall describe the methods and procedures used to conduct the analysis of knowledge, skills, and desired attitudes. It shall also provide detailed narratives, descriptions, flow diagrams, and other information on any taxonomies, typologies, or classification strategies used to identify knowledge, skills, and abilities and attitudes.

children.title: Performance profiles
children.content: This data shall include evaluation results and profiles for each task identified as follows:

children.title: Category of knowledge
children.content: The category of knowledge (e.g., general, physical, functional interface, operational maintenance, documentation, etc.) and the associated item number for each knowledge required shall be provided.

children.title: Category of skills
children.content: The category of skills (e.g., operation, maintenance, etc.) and the associated item number for each skill required shall be provided

children.title: Target population/entry skills analysis data
children.content: This data describes the results of the target population analysis conducted for each unique population type. It shall include evaluation reports and skill and knowledge profiles. These reports shall also contain estimations of the degree of retention, comprehension, and proficiency the target student population already possesses for the task and task activities identified to be trained. (Results of this analysis data establishes the training requirements baseline for each personnel type.)

children.title: Master task and skills data
children.content: This data shall contain the master task and skills lists for each type personnel. Lists shall be provided that show codes assigned to knowledge, skills, and task proficiency and allocated to each qualification level for each type personnel skill area.

children.title: Part 5: Mission Performance Standards (MPS)
children.content: The MPS shall include the following:

children.title: Number and title of the unit task
Combat conditions under which each unit task will be performed to include any equipment, tools, or manuals available to the unit as well as any environmental constraints
Criteria that constitute acceptable performance of the unit task
Evaluator instructions that provide general information which will be useful during the evaluation process
The designation (KI) shall be placed at the end of each statement of standards, to identify standards that are essential to unit performance of a task or that require additional explanation
Individual Training Standards (ITS)
children.content: The ITS shall contain the following:

children.title: ITS system data
children.content: ITS system data shall include:

children.title: Description of the ITS development process
Description of the use of ITSs
Description of the maintenance of ITSs
Listing of training devices and equipment
Listings of ordnance and other expendables required
ITS listings
children.content: ITS listings shall be provided for each occupational field duty area as follows:

children.title: Index of tasks
children.content: This index shall include an explanation of all abbreviations and shall also include the following information in table format:

children.title: Lowest grade required to perform this task
Common ITS listing
children.content: This listing shall include a cross-reference of ITS common to more than one occupational skill area within an occupational field. The listing shall contain the following:

children.title: Format (explains the format of the common listing)
Task titles, listed in one column with the common task numbers listed in a second column
Table of contents
children.content: A listing of task numbers and titles shall be given for each duty area.

children.title: Standard digital data
children.content: Standard digital data shall be delivered for the Standard Data Elements (SDEs).
